name: 4C-TFM
summary: 4C-TFM, also known as TFM-Ariadne or 4C-DOTFM, as well as 4-trifluoromethyl-2,5-dimethoxy-α-ethylphenethylamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and 4C families related to Ariadne (4C-D).

pharmacology.text: 4C-TFM, also known as TFM-Ariadne or 4C-DOTFM, as well as 4-trifluoromethyl-2,5-dimethoxy-α-ethylphenethylamine, is a serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist of the phenethylamine, phenylisobutylamine, and 4C families related to Ariadne (4C-D). The drug is a potent agonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A, 5-HT2B, and 5-HT2C receptors.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is known mainly from laboratory studies of serotonin receptors.
uses.zh: 它主要出現在血清素受體的實驗室研究中。
uses.zhHans: 它主要出现在血清素受体的实验室研究中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psychedelic phenethylamines, can cause nausea, dilated pupils, a faster heartbeat, raised blood pressure, muscle tension, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類的迷幻苯乙胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血壓升高、肌肉緊繃、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类的迷幻苯乙胺类药物，可能引起恶心、瞳孔放大、心跳加快、血压升高、肌肉紧绷、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its relative Ariadne, named by Alexander Shulgin after the heroine of Greek myth, was once tested as a medicine but never marketed. 4C-TFM carries a trifluoromethyl group, three fluorine atoms on one carbon.
fact.zh: 它的近親Ariadne由Alexander Shulgin以希臘神話中的公主阿里阿德涅命名，曾被當作藥物測試，但從未上市。4C-TFM帶有三氟甲基，也就是一個碳上接了三個氟原子。
fact.zhHans: 它的近亲Ariadne由Alexander Shulgin以希腊神话中的公主阿里阿德涅命名，曾被当作药物测试，但从未上市。4C-TFM带有三氟甲基，也就是一个碳上接了三个氟原子。
